name: PlaNet: Latent Dynamics Planning
summary: Learn a recurrent stochastic latent dynamics model from observations and plan future actions in latent space.
summary_zh: 由高维观测学习隐状态的随机动力学，并在潜在空间搜索动作。
core_idea: Combine learned latent transitions, multi-step prediction, and online model-based planning.
innovation: Makes planning feasible when image-level physical state is partially observed.
limitations: Latent model errors compound during multi-step rollout.
A learned control environment is not a validated patient-specific clinical twin.

start_here.why: Influential model-based world-model planning from pixels.
start_here.focus: Latent state model, observation inference, online planning.

curation_note: Representative publication checked; recommendations are advisory and application-specific clinical claims require separate evidence.
